name: simplereach
description: Chat with your free SignalREACH endpoints or Microsoft 365 Copilot, with a desktop tray on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

commands.title: REACH: Open Browser in New Tab
REACH: Send Browser Page to Chat

simplereach.endpoint.markdownDescription: Free endpoint base URL or the published endpoint-pointer URL. Used when Provider is Free endpoints.

simplereach.additionalEndpoints.markdownDescription: Additional endpoint base URLs or pointer URLs, listed under Other providers. Selecting one loads its models and routes chat to it. The access key applies to the selected provider.

simplereach.accessKey.markdownDescription: Access key for the original Free endpoints connection. Added endpoints use their own keys.

simplereach.agentMaxRounds.markdownDescription: Agent rounds (model ↔ tool exchanges) allowed per request. **0 = no limit** — the agent keeps working until the task is done or you press Stop. Set a positive number to pause at that many rounds instead.

simplereach.agentUnfinishedRetries.markdownDescription: Extra rounds REACH gives the agent when a reply *announces* work it never starts. **0 = no limit** — it keeps chasing the work; set a positive number to pause with “continue” after that many nudges.

simplereach.toolResultBudgetKb.markdownDescription: How much of a tool's result (KB) is kept in context (“read” always keeps the complete result). **0 = no limit** — the complete result is kept and automatic context compression protects the request size. Set a positive value to cap every other tool result.

simplereach.workspaceContext.markdownDescription: Include workspace source as context with every chat; Agent mode also selects and reads relevant closed files (default on — toggle it in the sidebar).

simplereach.contextMaxKb.markdownDescription: Workspace source budget (KB) per request. Complete files are included when they fit; omitted files are listed and can be read with the read tool.

simplereach.think.markdownDescription: WhisperThink — the model runs a private reasoning pass before answering. The reasoning is never shown in the chat flow (hover the 💭 chip on a reply to peek). Toggle in the sidebar.

simplereach.thinkModel.markdownDescription: Model used for the private reasoning pass (blank = same model as the chat).

simplereach.thinkMaxTokens.markdownDescription: Max tokens for the private reasoning pass.

simplereach.webSearch.markdownDescription: Web search — the model's question is turned into a search query, fresh results + page excerpts are injected before answering (DuckDuckGo; Playwright used for page fetching when installed).

simplereach.searchResults.markdownDescription: Max search results injected per question (1-10).

simplereach.playwright.markdownDescription: Use Playwright (headless Chromium) for page fetching when the module is installed in the extension folder. Falls back to plain HTTP fetching when unavailable.

simplereach.agentic.markdownDescription: Agentic mode — the model can propose file edits (shown as accept/reject diffs in the chat) using your workspace tree + open files as context.

simplereach.temperature.markdownDescription: Sampling temperature, 0–2. Leave blank to omit the parameter entirely and use the provider's own default.

simplereach.additionalHeaders.markdownDescription: Extra HTTP headers sent with every request, one `Name: value` per line. Applied after the built-in headers, so they can override defaults.

simplereach.agentTemplate.markdownDescription: Override the built-in agent instructions. Supports `{{workspace}}`, `{{model}}` and `{{provider}}`. Leave blank to use the built-in prompt. The fenced ```edit / ```tool output format is always appended so edits keep working.

simplereach.provider.description: Provider used by the REACH chat.

simplereach.trayExecutable.description: Optional path to the installed SignalREACH executable or AppImage. Leave blank for automatic discovery.

simplereach.selectedEndpoint.description: Endpoint chosen under Other providers. Empty selects the original Free endpoints connection.

simplereach.endpointAccessKeys.markdownDescription: Access keys for added endpoints, indexed by their exact URL. Set each key using the key button beside its endpoint in REACH Settings.

simplereach.dappUrl.markdownDescription: URL of your DApp frontend. **REACH: Preview DApp** opens the REACH Browser panel here; **REACH: Open DApp in Browser** opens it in your system browser.

simplereach.ideContext.markdownDescription: Include live VS Code editor, Git repository and installed-extension metadata when Workspace context is enabled. Adds on-demand diagnostics, PR, extension, task and language-navigation tools. Credentials, environment variables and other extensions’ private state are not collected. Review with **REACH: Inspect VS Code Context**.
